headline: Capital Trust transitions its AI-powered gold loan business from pilot to platform
hook: Pilot phase ends for AI gold loans
summary: Capital Trust Limited has announced that its A-Eye powered gold loan business has moved from the pilot stage to a full platform operational model. The press release details this strategic shift in the company's lending operations as of October 5, 2026. Retail investors tracking non-banking financial companies should note the commercialization of this tech-driven product offering. This scaling up could impact the company's asset growth and operational efficiency in the upcoming quarters.
whats_next: Watch quarterly earnings for growth in the gold loan segment.
why_it_matters: Tech-driven loan expansion may improve Capital Trust's growth metrics.
winners_losers: Capital Trust gains / traditional lenders challenged
